newsitem.title: JAPAN: Shohkoh Fund rises to all-time high.
newsitem.headline: Shohkoh Fund rises to all-time high.

text.p: Shares in Shohkoh Fund & Co Ltd advanced to an all-time high on Wednesday, encouraged by the recent recovery in the over-the-counter (OTC) index and the company's expected solid earnings, traders said.
The financing firm stood at 31,000 yen at 0150 GMT. It briefly rose to 31,100, an all-time high. Volume was 41,900 shares.

A trader at a second-tier securities house said: "The OTC index jumped above the 13-week moving average for the first time in 10 months, encouraging investors to resume buying shares in the OTC market. Shohkoh Fund was attracting foreign and domestic investors, as well as individual investors."
